content: Yesu Kristo Kwɩɩ́
Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, Roma owíe dɛhɛn Augusto lɔ́wa mbla ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋkláa ahá ánɩ́ bʋbʋ Romafɔ asɩ fɛ́ɛ́, abʋwanlɩn amʋ́ adá.
Mʋ́gyí ahákla gyankpapʋ nɩ. Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, oyin ɔkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Kirenio dɛ́ Siria ɔmásʋ́ gyí.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔhagyíɔha lɔ́yɔ dá ɔwanlɩ́nkpá mʋ onutó wúlutɔ.
Yosef ɛ́ lɔ́kʋsʋ́ tsú Nasaret wúlu ánɩ́ ɩbʋ Galilea ɔmátɔ́ dʋ́ yɔ́ Yudea ɔmátɔ́, Owíe Dawid wúlutɔ Betlehem. Tsúfɛ́ Owíe Dawid mʋ na ógyi.
Mʋa Maria amʋ́ʋ́ bapʋ́há mʋ bɛɛ otsía, ɔna odwinsʋ ámʋ nyɔ lɔ́yɔ dá ámʋ ɔwanlɩ́nkpá.
Brɛ́á bʋbʋ Betlehem ɩnʋ á, ɩkwɩ́ɩ lɛkan Maria,
ɔlɔkwɩɩ́ mʋ bitɩ́, ogyi oyin. Ɔlɛkɩklɩ́ɩ mʋ wá tatidatɔ, pʋ́ mʋ tswɩ mbwɩ atogyihɛ dákatɔ, tsúfɛ́ bʋmenya otsiákpá afɔɔ́ ɔswɩɩ́kpá.
Akúfa Akpapʋ́ Pʋ́ Bulu-abɔpʋ
Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, akúfa akpapʋ́ akʋ bʋbʋ ɩnʋ fʋ́n dimbítɔ́, bʋdɛ amʋ́ akúfa ɩwɩ gyo onyé.
Bulu-ɔbɔpʋ lɛ́lɛ ɩwɩ ɔwan súná amʋ́, Bulu numnyam lɔ́wankɩ́ wʋ́lɩ́ amʋ́sʋ́. Mʋ́ sʋ ifú lɛhɩɛ kɩ́tá amʋ́.
Ɩnʋ á, Bulu-ɔbɔpʋ amʋ lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩmánya ifú! Mlɩkɩ, napʋ́ asʋn wankláán ánɩ́ ɩbɔ́wa mlɩa ɔyɩ́tɔ́ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ ansigyí ba mlɩ.
Ndɛ bakwɩ́ɩ́ nkpa Ɔhɔ́pʋ, anɩ Wíe Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli amʋ) há mlɩ Owíe Dawid wúlutɔ!
Tɔ́á mlɔ́pʋbɩ́ mʋ gyí, mlówun kebi bɔbwɛ ɔkʋá bapʋ́ tatida kɩ́klɩ mʋ ɩwɩ, ɔda mbwɩ atogyihɛ dákatɔ.”
Ɔtsáwʋlɛ pɛ́ á, Bulu-abɔpʋ tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bɛba bɛtsɩá Bulu-ɔbɔpʋ amʋtɔ, bʋdɛ Bulu kanfʋ́ bɛɛ,

content.text: “Mlɩha apʋ numnyam ha Buluá ɔbʋ ɔsʋ́sʋ́ʋ́sʋ́!
Ɩwɩ ilwii ahá ánɩ́ Bulu ansɩ́ tegyi amʋ́ ɩwɩ ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ.”

content: Brɛ́á Bulu-abɔpʋ amʋ beyinkí yɔ́ ɔsʋ́sʋ́ á, akúfa akpapʋ́ ámʋ bɛbláa aba bɛɛ, “Mlɩha ayɔ Betlehem, ayɛkɩ ɩtɔ́ ánfɩ ɩlaba, Bulu lalɛ́ súná anɩ ánfɩ.”
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ bɔwa ɔsa yɔ́. Lɛ́lɛ́ á, bowun Maria mʋa Yosef pʋ́ kebi bɔbwɛ amʋ, ɔda mbwɩ atogyihɛ dákatɔ.
Brɛ́á bowun kebi ámʋ a, bɛlɛ mʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ bonu ámʋ blɩ́.
Akúfa akpapʋ́ asʋ́n ánfɩ lɔ́wa ahá ánɩ́ bonu mʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ wánwan.
Támɛ Maria mʋ́ lɛ́kɩtá asʋ́n ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ wá nwuntɔ, tsíá gywɩɩ́n mʋ́ ɩwɩ.
Brɛ́á akúfa akpapʋ́ ámʋ beyinkí bɔyɔ́ á, bʋna bʋdɛ Bulu adábi da, kánfʋ́ mʋ, asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ bonu pʋ́ ɩtɔ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ bayówun fɛ́ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu-ɔbɔpʋ amʋ lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ámʋ sʋ.
Yesu Ɩdá Dɩnká
Kebi ámʋ obuto ɔlɛkɛ́ á, bɛtɩn mʋ keté, dɩ́nká mʋ dá Yesu. Ɩdá ánfɩ Bulu-ɔbɔpʋ amʋ lɛ́ha mʋ asa mʋ yin lénya mʋ ɔmɛ́ nɩ́.
Yesu Pʋya Bulu Ɔtswɛ́kpa
Brɛ́á mʋ akwɩɩ́pʋ́ bɔ́gyʋráa ɩwɩ Mose Mbla ɔnɔ́ lɔfʋn a, bɔpʋ mʋ dʋ́ yɔ́ Yerusalem, pʋ́ mʋ yɔ́pʋ wá Bulu ɩbɩtɔ.
(Tsúfɛ́ bɔwanlɩ́n wá Mose Mbla ámʋtɔ bɛɛ, “Ilehián ánɩ́ Israelfɔ bɔ́pʋ amʋ́ bitɩ́ okugyíɔkʋ há Bulu.”)
Mʋ́ sʋ bɔyɔ́bɔ afɔdɩɛ ámʋ Mbla ámʋ ɔnɔ́. Abrɔ́dʋma anyɔ ntɛ́ɛ aklobi anyɔ bɔpʋbɔ́ alɩ afɔdɩɛ ánfɩ há Bulu.
Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, oyin dɛhɛn ɔkʋ bʋ Yerusalem, bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Simeon. Yilé ɔbwɛpʋ́ ógyi, otenyá Bulu ifú. Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ bʋ mʋsʋ, otsie ogyo brɛ́á Bulu ɔbɔ́pʋ Ɔlɛpʋ́ ba mʋ ahá Israelfɔ.
Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋ lɛ́lɛ súná mʋ ánɩ́ omóowu, yɔ́fʋn brɛ́á alawun Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli amʋ) asa.
Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋ lɛ́ha Simeon lɔ́yɔ Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́. Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ á, Yesu akwɩɩ́pʋ́ baba mʋ amándɩ́ɛ́ ánfɩ ɔbwɛkpá fɛ́ alɩá Mose Mbla ámʋ lɛblɩ́.
Ɩnʋ Simeon lɔ́hɔ kebi bɔbwɛ amʋ, ɔlɛkanfʋ́ Bulu ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: “Mɩ́ Wíé! Asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ fɛblɩ́ tswɩ amʋ ɩlaba mʋ́tɔ́.
Séi mʋ́ á, mɩ́ fʋ́ osúmbi anfɩ nɛ́talɩ́ wú iwilwiitɔ ngya.
Tsúfɛ́ mɩ́ onutó napʋ́ mɩ́ ansíbi wun Ɔlɛpʋ́ ámʋ.
Fʋ́ onutó falá mʋ bwɛ́ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ ansɩ́tɔ́.
Wankɩ ogyi, ɔbɛ́lɛ fʋ́ súná ahá ánɩ́ bʋmegyí Israelfɔ,
pʋ́ numnyam ba fʋ́ ahá Israelfɔ.”

content: Asʋ́n ánfɩ Simeon lɛ́blɩ́ tsú kebi bɔbwɛ anfɩ ɩwɩ lɛha ɔnɔ́ lobwie mʋ akwɩɩ́pʋ́.
Simeon lóyulá amʋ́, ɔlɛbláa obí mʋ yin Maria ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɩna kebi ánfɩ sʋ Israelfɔ ɔfan bɛ́dɩda, ɔfan ɛ́ bɛ́lɩɩ́. Osúna ogyi tsú Bulusʋ, ahá bɔ́kʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ mʋsʋ.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ Bulu ɔbɛ́ha ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ klʋnsʋ asʋ́n bɛ́lɩn ɔwan. Fʋ́ ɛ́ á, awɩrɛhɔ bɛ́hɩɛ kɩ́tá fʋ́ klʋn. Ɩbɔ́hɔ fʋ ɔsɩn fɛ́ ɔdayí ɩya anyɔ bakpíé yi fʋ.”
Ɔtsɩ dɛhɛn ɔkʋá ogyi Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ ɛ́ bʋ ɩnʋ. Mʋ dá gyí Hana. Mʋ sɩ gyí Fanuel, otsú Asa abusuantɔ. Ɔtsɩ dɛhɛn anfɩ mʋa mʋ kulu betsiá aba nfinsienɔ́, mʋ kulu lówu.
Olosu ɩsʋra alɩɩ bɔfʋn brɛ́á ɔlɔhɔ nfí adukwe-na (84). Ɔlɔpʋ Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ mlí mʋ ɔdɩkpa, ɔdɛ Bulu súm, klɩ́ ɔnɔ́, bɔ́ mpáɩ ɔpa mʋ́a onyé.
Mʋ ɛ́ ɔlɛdalɩ ba bɛkanfʋ́ Bulu, blɩ́ kebi bɔbwɛ amʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n súná ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋdɛ Yerusalemfɔ ɩwɩgyí ɔkpa kɩ́ɩ amʋ.
Yesu Yinkía Ya Nasaret Wúlutɔ
Brɛ́á Yesu akwɩɩ́pʋ́ bɔbwɛ amándɩ́ɛ́ ámʋ tá Bulu mbla ámʋ ɔnɔ́ á, beyinkí kplɩ́ yɔ́ amʋ́ wúlutɔ Nasaret, Galilea ɔsʋlʋ́sʋ.
Kebi ámʋ lɛ́dan, nyá ɔwʋnlɩ́n, nyá nyánsa, Bulu ɛ́ lóyulá mʋ.
Yesu Bʋ Bulu Ɔtswɛ́kpa
Yesu akwɩɩ́pʋ́ bʋtetsíá yɔ́ Yerusalem yégyi Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn Nkɛ ofífígyíofí.
Brɛ́á Yesu lɔ́hɔ nfí dúanyɔ á, mʋa amʋ́nyɔ bɔyɔ nkɛ ámʋ ogyíkpá fɛ́ alɩá bʋtɔyɔ́ yáɩ́.
Brɛ́á begyi nkɛ ámʋ tá beyinkí á, Yesu akwɩɩ́pʋ́ bʋmɛbɩ ánɩ́ alasin ɩnʋ.
Bʋkɩ bɛɛ mʋa mʋ abanyɔ ná. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛnatɩ́ ɛkɛwʋ́lɛ owítɔ́ asa bɔwa mʋ dunká apíó abatɔ bɩ.
Brɛ́á bodunká mʋ kásíán á, beyinkí yɔ́ Yerusalem, yódunká mʋ.
Ɛkɛ sáásɩ́ a, boyówotií mʋsʋ Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ. Otsie Mose mbla asunápʋ́ wá, ɔdɛ asʋ yáa amʋ́ asʋ́ntɔ́, ɔdɛ amʋ́ asʋ́n fɩtɛ́.
Ɔnɔ́ lobwie ahá ánɩ́ bʋbʋ ɩnʋ fɛ́ɛ́, tsú alɩá ɔdɛ asʋ́n ámʋ asɩ nu pʋ́ alɩá ɔdɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ lɛ.
Ɔnɔ́ lobwie mʋ akwɩɩ́pʋ́ brɛ́á bowun mʋ. Mʋ yin lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ bí, ntogyi sʋ fabwɛ́ anɩ alɩ? Mɩ́a fʋ́ sɩ́nyɔ ansɩ́ lapɛ́ anɩdɛ́ fʋ́ dunká.”
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ mlɩdɛ́ mɩ́ dunká? Ilehián ánɩ́ mlɛ́bɩ ánɩ́ mɩ́ Sɩ́ wóyítɔ́ nétsiá.”
Támɛ mʋ akwɩɩ́pʋ́ bʋmonu asʋ́n ánɩ́ ɔdɛ amʋ́ bláa asɩ.
Mʋa amʋ́nyɔ beyinkí yɔ́ Nasaret, ɔlɛba ɩwɩasɩ há amʋ́. Maria lɛ́kɩtá asʋ́n ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ wá kpawunutɔ, tsíá gywɩɩ́n mʋ́ ɩwɩ.
Yesu lɛ́dan, wa ɔwʋnlɩ́n, nyá nyánsa, Bulu mʋ́a anyánkpʋ́sa fɛ́ɛ́ ansɩ́ legyi mʋ ɩwɩ.
